name: Ridgecrest home drives (owner's real-drive test area)
purpose: Full layered coverage of three drives the owner will test in a real car. Built layer by layer, with the cost checked after each.

routes.description: Ridgecrest west on CA-178 to Inyokern, south on US-395 and CA-14 past Freeman Junction, Red Rock Canyon, Cantil, Mojave, and Rosamond to Lancaster.
Ridgecrest west on CA-178 through Inyokern and Freeman Junction, over Walker Pass, down the South Fork Kern River valley through Onyx, Weldon, and Mountain Mesa to Lake Isabella.
Ridgecrest east on CA-178 to Trona and the Searles Valley; separately, Ridgecrest south on US-395 through Johannesburg, Randsburg, and Red Mountain.

counties.name: Kern County
counties.focus: The drives cross only eastern Kern County: the Indian Wells Valley, the El Paso Mountains, Red Rock Canyon, the Fremont Valley, Mojave and Rosamond, Walker Pass, and the South Fork Kern River valley to Lake Isabella. Most cards should be about that side of the county. A handful of county-wide cards (how the county was formed, its size and government, its economy) are fine; Bakersfield, oil fields, and San Joaquin Valley farming only as brief context.

counties.name: San Bernardino County
counties.focus: The drives cross only the county's northwest corner: the Searles Valley (Trona, Argus, Westend, Pioneer Point) and Red Mountain. Cards about that corner, plus a few about the county as a whole (the largest county in the contiguous United States, if two sources say so; its federal lands).

counties.name: Los Angeles County
counties.focus: The drive reaches only Lancaster, at the northern edge. Cards about the Antelope Valley side of the county, plus a few county-wide (population, government size) that a driver arriving from the desert would find striking.

Burro Schmidt Tunnel; the El Paso Mountains; Last Chance Canyon
Randsburg, Johannesburg, and Red Mountain: the Rand mining district (gold, tungsten, silver)
Searles Lake and borax; Trona; the Trona Pinnacles
The Los Angeles Aqueduct crossing the region; the Jawbone siphon
Mojave Air and Space Port; Edwards Air Force Base; Rosamond and the Tropico gold mine
Antelope Valley: Lancaster, aerospace, the poppy reserve

note: Leads are things to research, not facts. Every card fact needs its own sources.

towns.name: Searles Valley (Trona)
towns.note: Trona is part of the Searles Valley census-designated place; cover Trona, Argus, Westend, and Pioneer Point.
